messages.subject: Whitmore settlement — fees invoice to claimant's solicitors
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Accounts,

Please raise our disbursement note and separately note that under the settlement the Company is to pay £5,000 plus VAT to Ashworth Quinn LLP as a contribution to the claimant's legal fees. Their invoice will be addressed to Dr Whitmore but marked payable by Ashbourne. I'll forward it when received. The £185,000 termination payment is being paid by the client directly to the claimant, not through us.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
